mapper.sql: m.id, m.component_key, m.display_name, m.description, m.provider_type, m.base_url, m.model_name, m.credential_id, c.credential_key, m.options_json, m.enabled, m.revision, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_at
from ai_model_profile m left join ai_credential c on c.id = m.credential_id
mapper.insert: insert into ai_model_profile ( id, component_key, display_name, description, provider_type, base_url, model_name, credential_id, options_json, enabled, revision, created_by) values (#{id}, #{key}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{providerType}, #{baseUrl}, #{modelName}, #{credentialId}, cast(#{optionsJson} as jsonb), true, 0, #{actor})
mapper.update: update ai_model_profile set display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, model_name = #{modelName}, credential_id = #{credentialId}, options_json = cast(#{optionsJson} as jsonb), enabled = #{enabled}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and revision = #{expectedRevision}
